brief: Compare equal and income-proportional shared contributions under explicitly agreed rules.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Share Costs"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Acuerda cómo compartir costos"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Combine como dividir custos"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare equal and income-proportional shared contributions under explicitly agreed rules.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Equal payments and income-based payments are different rules; use fictional dollars to compare an agreed arrangement.
instruction.misconception: Equal contributions and equal income proportions always mean the same payment, or one rule is universally fair.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Equal splits use the same amount per person. Income-proportional splits use each person’s share of combined income; agree the rule.
Ana pays her agreed share of combined income.
Identical amounts define this equal split.
Divide the bill by the agreed number of equal contributors.
Lea contributes her income share of the combined total.
Changed income may change contributions under the agreed method.
Fairness requires an agreement that considers the actual circumstances.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Equal payments and income-based payments are different rules; use fictional dollars to compare an agreed arrangement.

es-MX.line: Pagos iguales y proporcionales al ingreso son reglas distintas; usa pesos ficticios para comparar un acuerdo.

pt-BR.line: Pagamentos iguais e proporcionais à renda são regras distintas; use reais fictícios para comparar um acordo.

en-US.line: Equal splits use the same amount per person. Income-proportional splits use each person’s share of combined income; agree the rule.

es-MX.line: Divisiones iguales usan el mismo monto por persona. Proporcionales usan la parte del ingreso conjunto de cada quien; acuerden la regla.

pt-BR.line: Divisões iguais usam o mesmo valor por pessoa. Proporcionais usam a parte da renda conjunta de cada pessoa; combinem a regra.

en-US.prompt: Agreed income shares: Ana earns 1000, Bo 3000; shared bill 800. Find Ana’s contribution.

feedback.met: Ana pays her agreed share of combined income.
feedback.not_yet: Find combined income, then Ana’s share of the bill.

help: Find combined income, then Ana’s share of the bill.

es-MX.prompt: Proporción acordada: Ana gana 1000, Bo 3000; cuenta compartida 800. Calcula aporte de Ana.

feedback.met: Ana paga su parte acordada del ingreso conjunto.
feedback.not_yet: Calcula ingreso conjunto y luego parte de Ana.

help: Calcula ingreso conjunto y luego parte de Ana.

pt-BR.prompt: Proporção acordada: Ana ganha 1000, Bo 3000; conta conjunta 800. Ache aporte de Ana.

feedback.met: Ana paga sua parte acordada da renda conjunta.
feedback.not_yet: Ache renda conjunta e depois a parte de Ana.

help: Ache renda conjunta e depois a parte de Ana.

en-US.scene: Two adults agree to pay identical amounts toward a shared bill.
help: Use the agreed rule rather than assume income proportions.

feedback.met: Identical amounts define this equal split.
feedback.not_yet: Use the agreed rule rather than assume income proportions.

feedback.not_yet: Usa la regla acordada sin suponer proporciones de ingreso.

pt-BR.scene: Dois adultos combinam valores idênticos para uma conta conjunta.

feedback.met: Valores idênticos definem esta divisão igual.
feedback.not_yet: Use a regra combinada sem supor proporções de renda.

help: Use equal amounts, not an unstated income rule.

feedback.not_yet: Use equal amounts, not an unstated income rule.
